questions.q: Eagle, Republic, Cemex and Holcim all make:
questions.n: These are the big local cement brands.

questions.q: Philflex makes:
questions.n: Philflex is a local wire and cable brand.

questions.q: Jackbilt is a Philippine brand best known for:
questions.n: Jackbilt makes CHB and precast concrete products.

questions.q: Lawanex is a brand of:
questions.n: Lawanit and Lawanex are hardboard products.

questions.q: Which manufacturer makes both "Liquid Tile" masonry coating and "Bio-fresh" interior paint?
questions.n: Both are Davies Paints products.

questions.q: Which is NOT an elevator company?
questions.n: Schlage makes locks.

questions.q: Which of these is a Portland cement producer in the Philippines?
questions.n: Holcim makes cement; the others make tiles, steel and PVC products.

questions.q: Riviera and Tegula are both brands of:
questions.n: Riviera Filipina and Tegula Filipina make concrete roof tiles.

questions.q: "Acrytex" solvent-based acrylic is sold under which paint brand?
questions.n: Acrytex is a Boysen product line.

questions.q: Elastoseal roof sealant and Mighty Bond adhesive come from the same Filipino company. Which?
questions.n: Both are Pioneer Adhesives products.

questions.q: Thoroseal and Sureseal reach Philippine sites through which distributor?
questions.n: Jardine Distribution carries the Thoro line of cementitious waterproofing.

questions.q: Which brand would you check for PVC downspouts and gutters?
questions.n: Crown makes PVC pipes, gutters and downspouts.

questions.q: SOSS is a brand known for:
questions.n: SOSS hinges disappear when the door is closed.

questions.q: Which is best known as a CCTV and surveillance brand?
questions.n: Hikvision specializes in surveillance gear; Aiphone makes intercoms.

questions.q: Megacryl belongs to which maker's product family?
questions.n: Megacryl is Davies; Permacoat and Elastikote are Boysen.

questions.q: Neltex, Emerald and Atlanta are all brands of:
questions.n: All three make PVC/PPR piping.

questions.q: Which is the dominant local maker of steel reinforcing bars?
questions.n: SteelAsia is the largest rebar producer in the country.

questions.q: Which is a rebar manufacturer?
questions.n: Capitol Steel makes reinforcing bars.

questions.q: Manhole covers and cast gratings: which local supplier?
questions.n: Jaman is known for cast-iron manhole covers and gratings.

questions.q: APO Color Roof is made by:
questions.n: APO is Puyat Steel's pre-painted roofing brand.

questions.q: Hornitex is a brand of:
questions.n: Hornitex makes laminated wood floors.

questions.q: Fire-rated, moisture-resistant and acoustic gypsum boards are associated with which brand?
questions.n: Knauf is the leading drywall brand in the market.
